name: Yeshocq
description: Yeshocq was a planet located within the Yeshocq system of the Mid Rim. It was a colonized, forested, temperate planet with a local year that lasted 13 standard months: the local year was divided into 455 local days. Yeshocq was the homeworld qormot species.
